# SHEEPDOG - K. Semrad - DREAMER 15 p.8 (PDF page 10) - CHIP-8 + 6800, 0090-03FF, run C000
# (0080-0091 = sheep positions, set at run time.) Bauer joystick moves the dog (VC/VD, the
# joystick service routine is built in at 0204-0267, hooked on the IRQ vector by 0200 = call
# 0204); key F = bark: the sheep nearest to the dog moves away from it. Get all the sheep into
# the little paddock in the top left corner; one sheep is lame, the others run off (a sheep
# out of reach shows as a dot "in the distance"). 0257 (hor.) and 0260 (vert.) = joystick
# offsets subtracted from the raw counts.
# 02D8: printed "8?B0" with a handwritten 6 over the second digit: 86B0 (V6 = VB, like 85A0).
